blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Adamson scraped past La Salle, 63-60, in the final game of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball first round on Sunday night at Ateneo Blue Eagle Gym. Matt Erolon buried a clutch triple that put the Soaring Falcons in front, 61-58, with 30 seconds left before Manu Anabo sank two free throws with nine ticks to go to seal their team’s fourth victory in seven games. “We should be happy with where we are at right now,” said coach Nash Racela after his squad bounced back from a narrow loss to […]...
